messages:
kyle: FYI eu-west3 scratch cohort-9 experiencing sustained NVMe IOPS spike ~3x normal. GPU attaches timing out. Suspect scrub + fstrim overlap.
maria: Any node examples / logs?
kyle: gn-eu3-142 shows nvme qdepth explosion and blk_mq qfull errors. Janitor reports: iops=62k backlog=12.
raj: Can we throttle janitor for that cohort instead of mass-replacing nodes? Defer scrub if SMART looks stable.
nana: Proposed steps: pause scrub for 30m, divert new attaches to dedicated pool for 20m, only replace nodes if SMART thresholds breach.
infra-bot: ALERT nvme_iops_spike scratchpool-cohort-9 nodes gn-eu3-138..gn-eu3-144. Autoscaler paused attaches:4 in last 10m.
ops-sre: Approved. Use ops API to set janitor ratecap: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/v1/janitor/ratecap -d '{"cohort":"cohort-9","iops_cap":30000,"duration":"30m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'`
kyle: Applying ratecap and tagging hot nodes: `tag node gn-eu3-142 nvme:hot=true` and creating temporary route to eu-west3-dedicated-1.
maria: Attach success jumped 68%->92% after ratecap within 5m. Good.
raj: Cost hit note: routing to dedicated pool is more expensive (~0.8c/op delta), estimate +$1.2k/day if prolonged. Keep window short.
nana: Running quick safety eval for deferring scrubs. If SMART trends up we switch to replacement.
ops-sre: Created postmortem stub in #postmortems and recorded decision. Avoid replacements for now.
kyle: TL;DR: throttle janitor 30m, reroute attaches to dedicated for short window, monitor SMART and attach SLOs. Will update. :white_check_mark:
